description: Allows a mob to panic when receiving damage, making it run around and away from the damage source that made it enter this state.

damage_sources.description: The list of damage sources that will cause this mob to panic.

force.description: If true, the mob will stop panicking only when it can no longer find positions to run away to, or when the goal is removed.

ignore_mob_damage.description: If true, the mob will not panic in response to damage from other mobs. This overrides the damage types in "damage_sources".

panic_sound.description: Sound to play while the mob is panicking.

prefer_water.description: If true, the mob will prefer water over land.

sound_interval.description: Range of random ticks to wait between playing the panic sound.

speed_multiplier.description: Movement speed multiplier when using this goal.

title: minecraft:behavior.panic
